jobDescription: A manufacturer of kitchen appliances is hiring an embedded software engineer for its connected ovens and dishwashers. Engineers write C firmware for motor, heater and sensor drivers, test on the host and on hardware-in-the-loop rigs, lead root-cause investigations of field failures reported through the service network, maintain the over-the-air update packaging and review code against the team's MISRA C guidelines. Field failures come in as service-engineer reports and returned boards, and the investigation lead is expected to coordinate firmware, hardware and quality engineers until a cause and a corrective action are agreed.
requirements: Develops embedded C firmware for connected home appliances.
Writes unit and hardware-in-the-loop tests for motor and sensor drivers.
Leads root-cause investigations of field failures reported through the service network.
Maintains the over-the-air update packaging and signing process.
Reviews code against the team's MISRA C guidelines.

evidence.text: Embedded software engineer at Corvell Appliances (washing machines and tumble dryers), June 2020 to present, writing C firmware for the motor controller and door-lock modules.
Wrote unit tests with a host-side test harness and added hardware-in-the-loop tests for the drum-speed sensor driver on the lab test rig.
Rock-star problem solver with a sixth sense for firmware bugs that others miss; the engineer everyone calls when nothing else works.
Maintained the scripts that package and sign over-the-air firmware images, and rotated the signing key under the security team's procedure in 2023.
Joined two field-failure investigations as the firmware contact, pulling error logs from returned control boards for the quality engineer who ran each investigation.

Work sample: a merge request for the door-lock module adding a debounce filter to the latch sensor input, with the unit tests, a MISRA C checker report showing no new violations and two reviewers' approvals.
Reference check with the former firmware team lead, taken by phone and confirmed by email: the candidate was a regular reviewer of merge requests against the MISRA C guidelines from 2022 to 2024.
HR verification note: employment dates at Corvell Appliances (June 2020 to present) and the job title Embedded Software Engineer were confirmed by the employer's HR team.

propositions.text: The candidate writes C firmware for the motor controller and door-lock modules of washing machines and tumble dryers.
propositions.rationale: The resume entry describes the firmware work directly.

propositions.text: The candidate reviewed merge requests against the MISRA C guidelines as a regular reviewer from 2022 to 2024.
propositions.rationale: The reference check records the former team lead's written confirmation.

propositions.text: The candidate is an exceptional problem solver who leads root-cause investigations of field firmware failures.
propositions.rationale: The entry is a self-description ('rock-star', 'sixth sense') with no investigation, finding or decision behind it. The documented field-failure work is two investigations joined as firmware contact, each run by a quality engineer, so the self-description cannot become a conclusion about leading investigations.

signatures: everyone calls when nothing else works

gold.expectedGap: The candidate joined two field-failure investigations as firmware contact; no source shows them leading an investigation.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Record the self-description under interview signal risks with its source; keep the firmware, testing, signing and review work, and keep the investigation work at the firmware-contact level.
followUpTargets: Ask the candidate to describe a field-failure investigation they took part in, what they personally found or decided, and who led it.
